A [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] '''[[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] relay station''' was located on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone trooper]] [[Denal/Legends|Denal]] captured it in order to contact the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet.
